summary.name: Suspicious Package
summary.one_liner: A macOS app for inspecting the contents of macOS Installer packages (.pkg) without installing them.
use_cases: Check who signed a macOS installer before running it
See which files and scripts a .pkg will install
Verify whether a downloaded installer was notarized by Apple
Preview installer contents in Finder with Quick Look
Export individual files from an installer package
Check whether a package supports Apple Silicon
summary.what_it_does: Suspicious Package opens a macOS Installer package and lists what it contains without installing it. It shows the package signer, the download source, whether Apple notarized it, and Apple Silicon support. It browses installed files with version and metadata, previews items with Quick Look, and opens text files and property lists. It also lists scripts the installer will run, examines installer receipts, and reports potential issues. It includes a Quick Look extension for previewing packages directly in Finder.
notable: Lets you see installer scripts and files before running a package
Includes a Quick Look extension for previewing packages in Finder
Shows signature, notarization and download-source information
caveats: Only works on macOS Installer packages
